room_setup.other: See floor plan [ATTACHMENT]. Reception in the anteroom; dinner in the Grand Hall. Ivory floor-length linen, forest napkins, no overlay, centerpieces under 16 inches, no open flame. Bars in the anteroom, skirted charcoal. Registration and auction tables skirted ivory. Florals house seasonal branches plus client-provided centerpieces. Seat capacity 280.

av.notes: House production. Program cue sheet due 7 days prior. Tech call 17:00. House operator on the call.

billing.notes: Sponsorship tables billed separately from general seating at [RATE]. Fictional auction proceeds are not handled by banquet accounts. Room, dinner, and [PACKAGE] bar on the master account. [DEPOSIT] due on signing. Authorized signer [SIGNER].

notes: Synthetic sample only. Coat check in the west foyer; quiet during the paddle raise. Vegan plates are the charred carrot and farro, not the cassoulet. Contact details on file.
